job.title: [Post] URGENT HIRING | SAP HYBRIS DEVELOPER | 2 POSITIONS We are urgently looking for experienced…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Hybris Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | 5+ years E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, with hands-on experience building data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, SQL performance tuning and production support. Skilled techno-functional consultant translating business requirements into robust SAP Commerce implementations.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP HYBRIS DEVELOPER
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Rupali Dahule’s urgent need for seasoned SAP Hybris talent to drive its e-commerce initiatives. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and OCC APIs that align perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: Integration
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring synchronized product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and third-party consumers, enhancing API reliability and performance.

bullets.label: Performance
bullets.text: Refactored complex FlexibleSearch queries and optimized SQL, cutting response times and improving transaction throughput.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Led production issue resolution and CI/CD deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), maintaining high availability for mission-critical e-commerce sites.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Rupali Dahule’s rapid expansion in the e-commerce sector presents a unique challenge that matches my passion for delivering robust SAP Hybris solutions. I admire the company’s commitment to leveraging cutting-edge commerce technology and its focus on scaling platforms for global reach. Joining your team would allow me to apply my proven integration and API expertise to accelerate your projects and drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Rupali Dahule accelerate its SAP Hybris roadmap, applying my five-year track record of high-impact integrations and API development to deliver fast, reliable e-commerce experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Hybris developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about your urgent Hybris openings and would love to discuss how my integration and API expertise can add immediate value.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud platform by implementing robust OCC APIs and streamlining PIM-ERP data pipelines, leveraging my experience with Profisee and DataHub. My background in CI/CD and Docker/Kubernetes will also ensure smooth, automated deployments and high-availability operations.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Hybris developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to Rupali Dahule’s urgent need for Hybris expertise and your focus on scaling e-commerce platforms. I can deliver robust OCC APIs, optimize PIM-ERP integrations, and ensure reliable CI/CD pipelines. I also noticed your emphasis on rapid delivery, and my proven track record aligns perfectly. Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.
